about.title: About
about.body: Football Star is a free football game in Hebrew, English and soon Arabic. It uses real league, club and player names, but ratings are our own and all crests and kits are original designs. If you'd like content removed, contact us and we'll handle it quickly.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Football Star ("we", "us") is a free, non-commercial football game website. This policy explains what information we collect, why, and how you can control it. We keep it short and collect as little as possible.

sections.heading: What we collect
body: Guests: you can play without an account. Your progress is stored only in your own browser (local storage) and never sent to us.
Account holders: if you sign in, we store your email address, the username you choose, your preferred language and your game progress (XP, level, daily streak, scores and saved games).
Google sign-in: if you choose "Continue with Google", Google shares your name, email address and profile picture with us. We do not get access to your Gmail, contacts, Drive or any other Google data.
We do not collect your age, phone number, address or any payment information, and there is no chat between users.

sections.heading: How we use it
body: To sign you in and keep your account secure.
To save your progress and show your username and scores on leaderboards (these are visible to other players).
We do not show ads, sell your data, share it for marketing or send marketing emails. The only emails we send are sign-in links you request.

sections.heading: Google user data
body: Information received from Google is used only to create your account, sign you in and show your name and picture in your profile. It is not shared with anyone, not used for advertising and not used to train AI models. Our use complies with the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.

sections.heading: Who processes your data
body: Supabase stores our database and handles sign-in. Vercel hosts the website. Both process data only to run the service for us.

sections.heading: Cookies and local storage
body: We use only essential cookies: a sign-in session cookie (when you are signed in) and a language preference cookie. Your theme choice and guest progress are kept in your browser's local storage. We use no tracking or advertising cookies.

sections.heading: Keeping and deleting your data
body: We keep your account data while your account exists. To delete your account and all data linked to it, email us at {email} from the address you signed up with. We will delete it within 30 days.

sections.heading: Children
body: Football Star is suitable for all ages and collects the minimum data needed. Children can play as guests without giving any personal information. If you are under 13 (or the minimum age in your country), please ask a parent before creating an account. Parents can contact us at any time to have their child's account deleted.

sections.heading: Security
body: Data is sent over encrypted connections (HTTPS) and protected by database access rules so each user can change only their own data. No system is perfectly secure, but we take reasonable steps to protect your information.

sections.heading: Changes and contact
body: If we change this policy, we will update the date at the top of this page. Questions or requests: {email}.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms apply to your use of the Football Star website. By using the site you agree to them. If you don't agree, please don't use the site.

sections.heading: The service
body: Football Star is a free, non-commercial football game. It is provided "as is". We may change, pause or stop any part of it at any time, and we don't guarantee it will always be available or error-free.

sections.heading: Your account
body: An account is optional. If you create one, you are responsible for activity on it. Usernames must not be offensive, hateful or impersonate another person. We may rename, suspend or delete accounts that break these terms.

sections.heading: Fair play
body: Please play fairly. Don't cheat, use bots or scripts, manipulate leaderboards, try to break or overload the site, or access other users' data. We may remove scores or accounts involved in such behaviour.

sections.heading: Football content
body: The game uses real names of leagues, clubs and players for entertainment and informational purposes. Football Star is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by any club, league, federation or player. Player ratings are our own opinion. All crests and kits in the game are original designs. To request removal of content, contact us at {email}.

sections.heading: Our content
body: The site's design, code, questions and original graphics belong to Football Star. You may not copy or redistribute them in bulk without permission.

sections.heading: Liability
body: To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any loss or damage arising from using the site, including loss of game progress.

sections.heading: Governing law
body: These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Israel.

sections.heading: Changes and contact
body: We may update these terms; the date at the top shows the latest version. Continuing to use the site means you accept the updated terms. Questions: {email}.

welcomeNight.text: The players at your new club invite you out for a welcome night.

reactions.go: That's how you start! You're one of us now 🍻

reactions.stay: A real pro. Exactly what I need before a game like this.

reactions.no: Oh... okay. I thought you'd help me.

reactions.post: The video blew up! Thousands of new followers 📈

gamingNight.text: The lads at the hotel are gaming until late.

reactions.join: You beat everyone! What a night.

reactions.stay: Your reactions are quicker. Good work!

reactions.rest: Smart call. A few days and you'll be good as new.

reactions.go: The kids couldn't stop smiling. You're their hero ❤️
reactions.skip: The kids were waiting for you... maybe next time.

reactions.home: You missed out! It was fun.

leadWarmup.text: The captain asks you to lead today's warm-up.
